Looking at this list, I need to find all distinct numbers and identify the second largest.

Let me extract the unique values and sort them:

```python
numbers = [-623, 946, -562, 452, 996, 353, 901, -72, 544, -374, 1, 187, 191, 726, -799, 988, 76, -423, 654, 169, -440, 519, -236, 60, 108, 165, -898, -30, 354, -479, 804, -526, -704, 325, 376, 261, 349, -65, -751, -92, -615, -5, 903, -562, 714, -691, -667, -680, 915, -73, 172, 166, 125, -749, -96, -12, -93, 81, -898, -647]

distinct_numbers = sorted(set(numbers), reverse=True)
print(f"Largest: {distinct_numbers[0]}")
print(f"Second largest: {distinct_numbers[1]}")
```

The **second largest distinct number is 988**.

(The largest is 996, followed by 988.)
